limitations: control windows are 9 blocks wide vs 18 for the target window
secondary: patch_cont: low<->no_history at the same site
selected_on: D only (Qwen S1-S5); no V task has been run for Qwen

site.necessity: block attention from every post-history position (incl. generated tokens) to NUM+HIST tokens in decoder blocks 9-26
site.sufficiency: replace hidden_states[27] at every post-history prompt position with the source condition's states (aligned from the end; token identity asserted)

success_rules.behavioral_knockout: greedy high-low gap reduction, CI lower bound > 0 (36 V tasks)
success_rules.behavioral_patch: greedy score shift toward source, CI lower bound > 0, both directions (36 V tasks)
success_rules.necessity: gap reduction >= 0.5 AND its CI lower bound exceeds the CI upper bound of both control windows
success_rules.sufficiency_both_dirs: mean normalized move >= 0.5 in both directions AND 95% CI of (site - L2 control) excludes 0
